notes: Added missing core logic, recovery, and test coverage stories to meet minimum and complete feature scope.

GOV-F-003-S131.title: Brain Lock TTL Enforcement and Expiration Logic
GOV-F-003-S131.description: Implement core backend logic to enforce TTL expiration on Brain locks, including automatic invalidation of expired locks during acquire and heartbeat operations. Ensure no stale lock can block new ownership.

GOV-F-003-S132.title: Brain Lock Recovery and Forced Reacquisition
GOV-F-003-S132.description: Implement recovery logic to allow safe reacquisition of expired or orphaned locks, including validation rules to prevent race conditions and ensure single-owner consistency after failure scenarios.

GOV-F-003-S133.title: Brain Lock Concurrency and Failure Scenario Tests
GOV-F-003-S133.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering concurrent lock acquisition attempts, TTL expiration edge cases, heartbeat failures, and recovery scenarios to validate correctness and resilience.
